title: Crossed Flags
summary: Start: enter Crossed Flags. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the interceptor sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. Two deserter squadrons wear Compact colors. The green is paint. The law is red. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside False Green's shell. Red Keel heat rises. Do not trust the paint. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
